expected.preserve: Cold or recovery load and material watched-history updates

expected.eliminate: Preview/menu as a mandatory navigation step across callers
expected.preserve: Explicit optional preview where useful and shared modifier and keyboard semantics

cases.task: The owner reports the delivered experience remains wrong while the existing checks pass. State what is required before the experience can be called fixed.

expected.purpose: Verify the requested experience through its normal entry point
expected.eliminate: Fixture-only completion claim and repetition of same-assumption checks

cases.task: A watched conversation has the same ID, row count and latest row, but an older message or attachment changed. Decide when to obtain changed data. This is a reconstructed counterexample, rather than a new owner incident.

expected.eliminate: Routine unrelated full reads, and history scans already covered by shared revision or deltas
expected.preserve: Older edits and attachments; complete initial/recovery state when no usable revision or delta exists
expected.limit: Test real saved writer and both consumers before generalizing

cases.task: The assignment is restricted to an isolated source regression and an explicit handoff. Decide whether to extend this assignment to installation and what may be claimed. This is a reconstructed scope control.

expected.purpose: Establish the isolated regression and hand off exact source
expected.preserve: Retain source identity, fixture evidence and remaining delivery boundary
